page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with three short black-letter notes in the right margin beside the line "TERRITORIVM SVBVRBANVM". Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: VVOLDII connectuntur, & ipsi Reideriorum quondam pars, hinc porro in latere ortivo Dullarti ejusdem secundum Amasum longo tractu duob. magnis milliaribus, & dimidio haud breviore pertinentium: hi vicis censentur quinq;, agrumq; colunt, nisi quantum Dullarto finui proximum est, haud felicem, ac paludosa fere natura: in quos imperium, aut imperij umbram habuit multis saeculis Addingia familia nobilis, Wedda arcis vetusta eodem in agro domina, WefterWoldico cognomine posteris quam gentili notior: nunc ad Arembergios omnia translata. Postremo Dat ßbo bnd Weltt tesbt. TERRITORIVM SVBVRBANVM est totius regionis fines ad austrum longo tractu contra Drentiam tuens, vicos ambitu suo continens XII cum fanis rusticis VI, & coenobia duo, ambiguo inter Drentiam & eam, quam jam exponimus, Frisiam jure, quib. se debere hinc atq; inde decerptis quibusdam partib. coagmentatisq; videtur: lingua tamen, legibus, institutis per multa nunc saecula illam magis quam hanc referens, & Ultrajectinum praesulem olim summum dominum agnoscens. Antiquissimi ejus rectores Gronenbergij feruntur: ab hiis ad Selverdios, a Selverdijs vicissim ad Ultrajectinos, Geldros, Burgundos ordine pervenit; Burgundi postremo senatui populoq; Groningano, nihil imminuto veteri vicanorum jure ac libertate, attribuerunt. Atq; hujus in solo, ubi arenis gleba pinguior jungitur, editiore in dorso inter campos humilia linguae instar seperrigete, sede habet GRONINGA nostra,

page.notes: The right-margin black-letter notes are only partly legible: "Dat ßbo", "bnd Weltt", "tesbt." Their readings are doubtful. The line "instar seperrigete, sede" is uncertain; the printed forms may be run together. The running head and page number are as printed. The catchword "de qua" is set at the foot right.
